curation_note.it: Lo studio regionale riporta 409,3 m³/s al colmo del 22 ottobre 2008 alla traversa dell'invaso minore sul Rio San Girolamo. ARCUS lo qualifica come ricostruzione ufficiale post-evento in una sezione a monte, non come misura strumentale né come portata alla sezione del ponte censito.
curation_note.en: The regional study reports 409.3 m³/s at the 22 October 2008 peak at the minor-reservoir weir on the Rio San Girolamo. ARCUS classifies it as an official post-event reconstruction at an upstream section, not as an instrumental observation or discharge at the recorded bridge section.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The value describes the named official station and is not assigned to the collapsed bridge section.
Sensor readings and post-event topographic surveys retain their distinct evidence types.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
No bridge return period or causal probability is inferred from the basin reference.
